Aqueous barium hydroxide, Ba(OH)2, reacts with dilute nitric acid, HNO3. The products are
aqueous barium nitrate, Ba(NO3)2, and water.
In a titration, 15.2cm3 of 0.75mol/dm3 aqueous barium hydroxide is required to neutralise
20.0cm3 of dilute nitric acid.
What is the concentration of the nitric acid?
